FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 352 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Labor annually by $600,000, as estimated by the department, for personnel, supplies, equipment, utilities, and indirect costs to implement the Alabama Pregnant Workers Fairness Act, which provides reasonable accommodations to employees with conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or a related medical condition.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary
